resolvedFindings: P2: a failed or missing exact-post load retained the ranking target and blocked a second selection of the same row; the accepted path reserves Loading synchronously and proves Failed-to-Loading-to-NotFound-to-Loading-to-Loaded recovery with the real ViewModel.

proves: Official Live ranking derives positions from every page returned by the existing total-order Official feed contract instead of only the visible first page.
A ranking is published only after the complete scan succeeds; malformed pages, duplicates and transport failures remain explicit retryable failures.
Selecting a ranked post outside the visible pager performs the exact-post read and supports retry after Failed or NotFound before navigating by stable post identity.
The affected shared implementation passes in Chrome/Wasm and compiles for Android and iOS x64 on the exact Product SHA.
doesNotProve: A native Android or iOS end-to-end interaction for the new complete-ranking panel.
Feed ranking completeness, media behavior or a global Live/Ranking end-to-end acceptance.
A new database deployment or production data mutation; the already deployed total-order RPC is reused unchanged.
